name: filebeat
description: Elastic Beat log shipper - tails log files, enriches events with modules (nginx, system, kubernetes), and forwards to Elasticsearch or Logstash

install_steps: curl -L -O https://artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/beats/filebeat/filebeat-8.17.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && tar xzf filebeat-8.17.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && ln -sf $(pwd)/filebeat-8.17.0-linux-x86_64/filebeat ~/.local/bin/filebeat
